summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long OPEN Daily ETF (OPEX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Opendoor Technologies Inc. (OPEN) OPEX was launched on Oct 22, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
